refsect1.title: Introduction
refsect1.para: systemd-rtwatchd.service8 is a system service that hands out realtime scheduling and high priority to threads of unprivileged processes. This page describes its D-Bus interface, which is compatible with the one implemented by RealtimeKit, and is provided under RealtimeKit's traditional bus name org.freedesktop.RealtimeKit1.

refsect1.title: The Manager Object
refsect1.para: The service exposes the following interfaces on the Manager object on the bus:

refsect2.title: Methods
refsect2.para: MakeThreadRealtime() makes the specified thread of the calling process realtime at the specified priority, which must be in the range 1…MaxRealtimePriority. The thread must be specified as kernel thread ID (as returned by gettid2), or 0 for the main thread of the process. Before calling this method the client must have set the hard limit of RLIMIT_RTTIME to a value no larger than RTTimeUSecMax. SCHED_RESET_ON_FORK is always set.
MakeThreadHighPriority() sets the nice level of the specified thread to the specified value, which must be in the range MinNiceLevel…19.

The MakeThreadRealtimeWithPID() and MakeThreadHighPriorityWithPID() variants operate on a thread of the specified process instead of the calling process. The process must be owned by the same user as the caller.

ResetKnown() demotes all threads the service handed out realtime scheduling or high priority to. ResetAll() demotes all realtime threads of the system (except for those of root, unless CanaryDemoteRoot=yes is set in rtwatchd.conf5). Suspend() demotes all known threads temporarily, until Resume() is called. Exit() makes the service terminate, which demotes all known threads too.

refsect2.title: Properties
refsect2.para: RTTimeUSecMax is the maximum hard limit of RLIMIT_RTTIME (in µs) clients must have set in order to be granted realtime scheduling. MaxRealtimePriority is the maximum realtime priority, and MinNiceLevel the minimum nice level handed out. See rtwatchd.conf5 for how to configure them.

refsect1.title: Security
refsect1.para: Making a thread realtime is authorized via the polkit action org.freedesktop.RealtimeKit1.acquire-real-time, making a thread high priority via org.freedesktop.RealtimeKit1.acquire-high-priority. By default both are granted to local users. ResetKnown(), ResetAll(), Suspend() and Resume() are authorized via the polkit action io.systemd.rtwatch.manage, which by default requires administrator authentication; root is always allowed. Exit() is only available to privileged clients.

refsect2.title: The Manager Object
refsect2.para: The interface was originally implemented by RealtimeKit. In systemd, MakeThreadRealtime(), MakeThreadRealtimeWithPID(), MakeThreadHighPriority(), MakeThreadHighPriorityWithPID(), ResetKnown(), ResetAll(), Suspend(), Resume(), Exit(), RTTimeUSecMax, MaxRealtimePriority, and MinNiceLevel were added in version 263.
